asked.item: Should I log in with Facebook to connect Instagram
Linked Facebook Page affects the connection
How to connect Instagram in Blotato

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state to use the Instagram login rather than Facebook and that a linked Facebook Page is not required.

steps.text: No, use your Instagram login, not your Facebook login.
Open Accounts, select Connect account, then Instagram.
Sign in with your Instagram login details, then approve the requested permissions.
The connection does not require a linked Facebook Page.
Blotato uses Instagram Login for professional accounts of type Business or Creator.
